name: EM Carry-to-Vol: Is Carry Still Working?
description: Ranks 5 EM FX pairs (BRL, MXN, ZAR, INR, IDR) by carry-to-vol at each month-end. Carry = local 3M/overnight rate minus US 3M T-bill (FRED). Vol = 21-day realized annualized vol from log returns. Carry-to-vol = annualized carry differential / realized vol. Cross-sectional rank at month-end. Top 2 (highest carry-to-vol) vs bottom 2 (lowest) terciles compared on 21-day forward EM currency appreciation. FX convention: positive return = EM currency strengthened vs USD. Turkey excluded (hyperinflation distorts carry signal). Middle tercile (rank 3) event marker added for rank distribution debugging.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL: IS CARRY STILL WORKING?
# =============================================================================
# Universe: USDBRL, USDMXN, USDZAR, USDINR, USDIDR (5 pairs, TRY excluded)
# Carry: local 3M/overnight rate minus US 3M T-bill (FRED, monthly, ffilled)
# Vol: 21-day realized close-to-close annualized volatility
# Carry-to-vol: annualized carry differential / realized vol
# Rebalance: calendar month-end
# FX convention: positive return = EM currency appreciated vs USD (inverted)
# Terciles: top 2 (highest carry-to-vol) vs bottom 2 (lowest carry-to-vol)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# LOCAL INTEREST RATES (FRED, monthly, ffilled to daily)
# Rate series (all in % per annum):
#   BRL: IRSTCI01BRM156N  — Brazil overnight call money rate
#   MXN: IR3TIB01MXM156N  — Mexico 3M interbank
#   ZAR: IR3TIB01ZAM156N  — South Africa 3M interbank
#   INR: INDIR3TIB01STM   — India 3M interbank
#   IDR: IR3TIB01IDM156N  — Indonesia 3M interbank
#   USD: DTB3             — US 3M T-bill (daily)
# =============================================================================

brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01MXM156N')()
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01ZAM156N')()
inr_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='INDIR3TIB01STM')()
idr_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IR3TIB01IDM156N')()
usd_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DTB3')()

# Forward-fill monthly rates to daily bars
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)
inr_rate = ffill(inr_rate_raw.result)
idr_rate = ffill(idr_rate_raw.result)
usd_rate = ffill(usd_rate_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY DIFFERENTIAL: local rate - USD rate (both in % p.a.)
# Positive = local rate advantage = carry trade favors long EM / short USD
# =============================================================================

# Asset-scoped: each FX pair uses its own local rate via conditional_select
# is_asset_ref() identifies which asset is running in this context
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDZAR')()
is_inr = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDINR')()
is_idr = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDIDR')()

local_rate = conditional_select(
    is_brl, brl_rate,
    is_mxn, mxn_rate,
    is_zar, zar_rate,
    is_inr, inr_rate,
    idr_rate
)

carry_diff = local_rate - usd_rate   # % p.a., e.g. 10.5 = 10.5% carry advantage

# =============================================================================
# REALIZED VOLATILITY: 21-day annualized close-to-close vol
# volatility() outputs decimal fraction (e.g. 0.08 = 8% annualized)
# =============================================================================

fx_ret = (close_fx - (close_fx >> 1)) / (close_fx >> 1)
realized_vol_21d = volatility(period=21)(fx_ret)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL RATIO
# carry_diff is in % p.a. (e.g. 10.5), vol is decimal fraction (e.g. 0.08)
# Normalize carry to decimal: carry_diff / 100 → then divide by vol
# Result: dimensionless ratio (e.g. 1.31 = 131% carry per unit of vol)
# Guard against near-zero vol to avoid division artifacts
# =============================================================================

carry_decimal = carry_diff / 100.0
carry_to_vol = where(
    is_valid(realized_vol_21d) and realized_vol_21d > 0.005,
    carry_decimal / realized_vol_21d
)

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK AT MONTH-END
# cs_rank: ascending=False → rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol (best carry)
# =============================================================================

ctv_rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(carry_to_vol)

# =============================================================================
# MONTH-END REBALANCE GATE
# Only evaluate signals at calendar month-end boundaries
# =============================================================================

is_month_end = is_period_boundary(period='month', boundary='end')(bar_idx)

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD RETURN: 21-day EM currency appreciation
# FX pair is USDXXX: falling pair = EM strengthening
# Invert: positive return = EM appreciated vs USD
# forward_returns on price series: (close[t+21] - close[t]) / close[t]
# Negate to get EM appreciation direction
# =============================================================================

fwd_ret_raw = forward_returns(period=21)(close_fx)
fwd_ret_em = -1.0 * fwd_ret_raw.result

# =============================================================================
# TERCILE CLASSIFICATION AT MONTH-END
# Top 2 (rank 1-2) = high carry-to-vol = "top tercile"
# Bottom 2 (rank 4-5) = low carry-to-vol = "bottom tercile"
# Evaluate rank and forward return only on month-end rebalance bars
# =============================================================================

is_top_tercile = is_month_end and is_valid(ctv_rank) and (ctv_rank <= 2.0)
is_bot_tercile = is_month_end and is_valid(ctv_rank) and (ctv_rank >= 4.0)

# Forward returns filtered to each tercile (for aggregation in reporter)
top_fwd_ret = where(is_top_tercile, fwd_ret_em)
bot_fwd_ret = where(is_bot_tercile, fwd_ret_em)

# Hit rate flags (ternary for correct mean = frequency, per S41)
top_hit = 1.0 if (is_top_tercile and is_valid(fwd_ret_em) and fwd_ret_em > 0.0) else 0.0
bot_hit = 1.0 if (is_bot_tercile and is_valid(fwd_ret_em) and fwd_ret_em > 0.0) else 0.0

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 1: CROSS-SECTIONAL SUMMARY TABLE
# Shows current snapshot: carry-to-vol rank, carry diff, realized vol, avg fwd return
# =============================================================================

cs_summary_table(
    title='EM Carry-to-Vol Scorecard (Current)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='EM Carry-to-Vol Scorecard',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry-to-Vol Rank', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry Diff (% p.a.)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Realized Vol (21d)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg 21d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    ),
    order=0
)(ctv_rank, carry_diff, realized_vol_21d, carry_to_vol, fwd_ret_em)

# =============================================================================
# OUTPUT 2: BAR CHART — Top vs Bottom Tercile Average 21d Forward Returns
# Does high carry-to-vol predict better EM currency appreciation?
# cs_bars with label_as_x_axis: assets grouped into top/bottom tercile bars
# Use separate series for top and bottom, aggregated via Mean
# =============================================================================

cs_bars(
    title='Does Carry-to-Vol Predict EM Returns? Top vs Bottom Tercile',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Mean,
    color_by_value=True,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Avg 21d Forward Return (EM Appreciation)',
    series_names=['Top Tercile (High C/V)', 'Bottom Tercile (Low C/V)'],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(values=(top_fwd_ret, bot_fwd_ret))

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Month-end carry-to-vol regime assignments
# Captures each rebalance date with rank, carry, vol, and forward return
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Top Carry-to-Vol (Rebalance)',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge, title='C/V Rank', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Carry Diff (% p.a.)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Realized Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='21d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_top_tercile, carry_to_vol, ctv_rank, carry_diff, realized_vol_21d, fwd_ret_em)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Bottom Carry-to-Vol (Rebalance)',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge, title='C/V Rank', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Carry Diff (% p.a.)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='Realized Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='21d Fwd Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(is_bot_tercile, carry_to_vol, ctv_rank, carry_diff, realized_vol_21d, fwd_ret_em)
